compute_mssd: compute the maximum symmetry-aware surface distance between estimated and ground-truth 6D pose
compute_mspd: compute the maximum symmetry-aware projection distance between estimated and ground-truth 6D pose
compute_rotational_error: compute the rotational error in degrees between two 3x3 rotation matrices
compute_translation_error: compute the translation error between estimated and ground-truth translation vectors
compute_mask_iou: compute the intersection over union between two binary segmentation masks
